name: Hawaiian Pork Burger Wrap with Grilled Pineapple, Zucchini & Onion
instructions: If using wooden skewers, place 8-12 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim zucchini and cut crosswise into 1-inch rounds. Peel, halve, and cut onion lengthwise into 1-inch wide wedges; place both in a medium bowl.

Cut off skin from pineapple, halve, and remove the core. Cut a portion of the pineapple into 8 thin slices to place on top of the burgers; set aside for serving. Large dice remaining pineapple and add to the bowl with the veggies.
Zest lime into the bowl with the veggies and pineapple (set lime aside for later); drizzle with oil, season with salt, and toss to combine.
Thread veggies and pineapple onto skewers and place on a plate; alternatively, you can cook the veggies and pineapple directly on the grill pan. (Reserve the bowl for later use.)
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, place skewers on the grill and cook, turning occasionally, until the veggies are charred and tender, 4-5 minutes. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic and ginger; add both to the reserved bowl.
Add pork, bread crumbs, soy sauce, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the garlic and ginger; use your hands to thoroughly combine. Form into 4 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.

When the skewers are done, coat the grill with oil. Place burger patties on the grill and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties, and grill an additional 3-4 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
While the burgers are cooking, cut reserved lime into wedges.
Separate the lettuce into leaves and layer one leaf on top of another to create 4 stacks.
To serve, divide lettuce stacks between plates; top with burgers, mayo, and two slices of pineapple. Place skewers on the side, squeeze with lime, and enjoy!
author: Mealime
